title: Engine: Novig read key refused
body: The GitHub engine is running and trading live, but its Novig read-only key is refused (signature does not match; the live feed answers 401). It is on the slow public route: 0.3 prices a second, scans take about 11 minutes, and about 6,900 books a scan are left out as too old. To fix: Settings > Cloud scan > Send a Novig read-only key on the phone that holds the management key (this replaces the secret). Trading and bids still work.
